items.abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning for human-AI interaction typically relies on a single large language model to simulate user behavior. We show that this approach systematically fails to generalize, and trace the failure to simulator collapse: because the simulator LLM is mode-collapsed, an LLM policy trained against it overfits to narrow strategies that exploit the simulator's dominant mode, and such a policy transfers poorly to unseen simulators and real users. We formalize this collapse theoretically and propo…

通过理论形式化崩溃，提出推理时Verbalized Sampling和训练时Co-Training（种群协同训练）。
两种方案在三个多轮基准上提升保持成功率（最高9%和14%），人类研究有相似增益，并保持策略多样性。

items.originalTitle: Hamilton-Zero: A Neural Tensor-Network Foundation Model for Ground States of Arbitrary Quadratic Qubit Hamiltonians

items.abstract: A central promise of useful quantum advantage is the ability to compute ground states of Hamiltonian systems beyond the reach of classical simulation methods. Here we demonstrate that this problem can be effectively amortized across an arbitrary and universal set of Hamiltonians by a foundation model with $\sim0.5$B variational parameters, trained with contemporary techniques from large language models and deep reinforcement learning. To do this, we formulate $\text{spin-}1/2$ quantum ground-state learning as mani…

使用约0.5B参数的基础模型，将基态学习表述为SU(2)^N上中心奇标量函数的流形变分优化，结合自定义自动微分、SU(2)副本交换Langevin采样器、分片自然梯度优化和KFAC优化器，预训练于数十万哈密顿量系统，微调至1024量子比特。

items.summary: 现代黑盒图像到视频(I2V)模型缺乏细粒度控制和可靠性。我们提出“智能体自我改进”框架，将视频合成重构为闭环、目标导向的优化。两阶段方法：第一阶段用多模态LLM迭代优化提示，通过Davidson场景图和常见错误问题评估语义遵从和伪影；第二阶段用贝叶斯优化协同优化随机种子和CFG尺度，由包括新VTA分数的质量指标引导。人类偏好研究中，智能体方法达到高达69%的胜率。
items.abstract: Modern black-box Image-to-Video (I2V) models offer powerful capabilities in automated content creation, yet their lack of fine-grained control and reliability presents significant challenges in professional workflows. Their inherent stochasticity causes minor variations in textual prompts or hyperparameters to yield drastically different outputs often necessitating inefficient, brute-force trial-and-error processes. To address these limitations, we introduce the ``Agentic Self-Improvement" framework, which reframe…
keyFacts: 如何提高黑盒I2V模型的可控性和可靠性，避免试错过程？
两阶段优化：mLLM迭代提示优化（含DSG查询和CMQ检测），贝叶斯优化协同优化种子和CFG尺度，使用VTA分数等质量指标。
智能体优化显著优于无引导搜索，人类偏好研究中胜率高达69%。

items.originalTitle: Structural Silence: When AI Infrastructure Fails Speakers of Underrepresented Languages
items.summary: 本文探讨AI基础设施对未被充分代表语言使用者的结构性障碍，以孟加拉语为例。识别四个相互关联的失败：网络内容占比不足0.5%、训练令牌赤字67:1、分词惩罚以及连接性排斥（农村36.5%对比城市71.4%）。论证数据集稀缺是结构性障碍，离线优先设计应作为公平导向的基础设施策略。
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence tools for education and language support are increasingly framed as scalable responses to access gaps in under-resourced communities. Yet the infrastructure underlying these tools, including training corpora, tokenization schemes, evaluation benchmarks, and deployment architectures, can systematically disadvantage speakers of underrepresented languages before a model is trained. This paper examines these structural barriers through Bengali, one of the world's most widely spoken languages, f…
keyFacts: AI基础设施如何系统性边缘化未被充分代表语言的使用者？

识别出四个相互关联的失败：网络存在差距、训练令牌赤字、分词惩罚和连接性排斥。

items.summary: Diagram-MMU是一个评估多模态大语言模型科学图表解析与理解能力的基准，包含3.7k图表和18.3k问题，覆盖六个领域，三个任务：图到代码解析、编辑和问答。评估12个模型发现图到代码任务更具挑战性，代理设置下多数模型解析和编辑性能提升但问答下降，Claude-4.6 Opus持续提升。
items.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been growing the capability for scientific writing and collaboration. For example, OpenAI Prism is a free workspace for scientific writing and collaboration. One important feature in Prism is turning scientific diagrams directly into LaTeX TikZ code. In this paper, we build a benchmark, Diagram-MMU, a multi-modal benchmark designed to assess MLLMs' ability for scientific diagram parsing and understanding. Diagram-MMU features 3.7k curated diagrams and 18.3k human-valid…
keyFacts: 如何评估多模态大语言模型在科学图表解析和理解方面的能力？

items.summary: HandEdit是一个大规模、具身感知的图像编辑数据集和基准，将人类手和手臂转换为不同灵巧机器人形态。包含超过200M个编辑实例，来自五个源数据集，涵盖26个URDF（13个仅手和13个手-臂配置）。建立了两个轨道的统一基准协议，并评估了11个图像编辑基线。
items.abstract: Robotic manipulation with dexterous hands is a cornerstone of Embodied AI, yet its progress is stifled by the high cost of collecting embodiment-aware teleoperation data. While abundant egocentric videos of human hands offer a scalable alternative, the profound discrepancies in appearance, articulation, and camera viewpoints between human and robotic data raise significant challenges for co-training. Though existing general image-editing models demonstrate strong capabilities, they lack necessary embodiment-specif…
keyFacts: 如何构建一个统一的大规模基准，以评估和推动将人类手部图像编辑为机器人手部的模型，从而促进灵巧机器人学习？
构建HandEdit数据集（超过200M实例，来自五个源数据集，涵盖26个URDF），建立基准协议（两个轨道），评估11个基线使用多维评估套件。

items.originalTitle: Look What the Probes Dragged In! Real-World Chest X-ray Shortcuts in MedCLIP

However, recent work reveals that CLIP-based models remain vulnerable to shortcuts. We investigate how real-world shortcuts manifest across different layers of the medical CLIP-based model, MedCLIP, and its vision encoder, a frozen ResNet-50. items.originalTitle: OpenVisTool: An Open Recipe for Synthesizing Instructive Visual Tool-Use Trajectories

items.originalTitle: D3D-GEN: Robot-Aware Domain-Grounded Interactive 3D World Generation for Social Robotics
items.summary: 社交导航的具身AI训练依赖仿真环境，但现有方法难以平衡真实性和可模拟性。本文提出D3D-GEN世界生成系统，结合领域代理和检索增强生成（RAG）管道，自动化收集领域知识并合成逼真平面图和物体布局。系统支持用户通过提示快速生成领域接地的交互式3D世界，不依赖固定3D模型数据库，输出可加载到Isaac Sim和Gazebo。已为住宅、医院和办公室等领域构建数据库并生成多个环境。

We propose D3D-GEN, a novel world generation system that combines a domain agent with a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline grounded in that domain. Our system enables users to rapidly generate domain-grounded, fully interactive 3D worlds by automating both the collection of domain knowledge and the synth…
keyFacts: 如何快速生成既真实又可模拟的领域接地交互式3D世界，用于社交机器人仿真？
结合领域代理与RAG管道，自动化收集领域知识并合成平面图和物体布局，无需固定3D数据库。

items.title: 地球观测嵌入作为概率天气降尺度的有效子网格描述符
items.originalTitle: Earth observation embeddings are effective sub-grid descriptors for probabilistic weather downscaling
items.summary: 全球天气再分析和预报在粗网格上解析大气状态，但站点级应用需要任意位置预测，且未解析地形和地表属性影响。现有概率降尺度器使用手工地形描述符。本文探讨地球观测基础模型能否提供可转移的子网格地表表征。通过压缩TESSERA嵌入（10米分辨率）作为局部描述符，增强卷积条件神经过程以降尺度约25公里的ERA5再分析场。在五个气候多样区域，嵌入改进了站点预测的点值和概率技能，CRPS技能分别提高11.5%（2米温度）和6.2%（10米风速）。
items.abstract: Global weather reanalyses and forecasts resolve the evolving atmospheric state on coarse grids, but site-specific applications require predictions at arbitrary locations where near-surface conditions also depend on unresolved terrain and land-surface properties. Existing probabilistic downscalers address this gap using hand-crafted topographic descriptors. We ask instead whether Earth observation foundation models can provide transferable sub-grid surface representations for probabilistic weather downscaling. We a…
keyFacts: 地球观测基础模型能否提供可转移的子网格地表表征，用于概率天气降尺度？
在卷积条件神经过程中增加由TESSERA嵌入压缩得到的局部地表描述符，用于降尺度ERA5粗网格场。
嵌入提高了五个区域的点值和概率预测技能，总体上CRPS技能改善11.5%（温度）和6.2%（风速）；改进在输入换为Aurora预测和新建站点时持续。

items.title: 校准押注过去：金融时间序列预测的后训练量化
items.originalTitle: Calibration Bets on the Past: Post-Training Quantization for Financial Time-Series Forecasting
items.summary: 金融预测模型常在全精度下开发，但部署时需低精度推理以减少内存和计算成本。后训练量化无需重训练即可部署，但激活量化需要校准：从历史数据估计激活范围并固定。本文系统研究PTQ中激活校准对S&P 500横截面波动率预测的影响，涵盖七种架构、八个测试年（2018-2025）和560个模型。发现8位时校准影响小，4位时成为主要决定因素；默认abs-max校准在受影响架构中消除11-62%的精度，百分位校准恢复53-94%。
items.abstract: Financial forecasting models are typically developed in full precision, yet production deployment often requires low-precision inference to reduce memory and computational cost. Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables such deployment without retraining. However, reliable activation quantization requires calibration: activation ranges are estimated from historical data before deployment and then remain fixed during future inference. The importance of this deployment choice for financial forecasting remains poorly…
keyFacts: 在后训练量化用于金融时间序列预测时，激活校准的选择对预测性能有何影响？
系统评估激活校准方法（abs-max和百分位）在PTQ下对七种架构、560个模型在S&P 500横截面波动率预测中的性能。

items.originalTitle: Regime-Gated Residual Mixture-of-Experts for Cross-Sectional Volatility Forecasting
items.summary: 针对波动率的制度依赖性及其对神经网络训练稳定性的影响，作者提出RG-ResMoE架构，在滚动时序验证中匹配信息、容量和超参数，用于预测1027只美股的五日已实现波动率。制度信息仅用于专家路由，而非直接预测。结果显示，RG-ResMoE在预测准确性和训练稳定性上优于容量匹配的MLP，在日本股票面板上也有类似提升。
items.abstract: Financial volatility is regime dependent, yet incorporating regime information into neural networks can also destabilize training. This paper asks where such information should enter a neural cross-sectional volatility forecasting model. We propose RG-ResMoE, a regime-gated residual m…

items.originalTitle: Video2Track: From Real-World Interaction Videos to Steerable Adversarial Closed-Track Testing for Automated Driving Systems
items.summary: 封闭赛道测试对自动驾驶系统验证至关重要，但现有方法依赖标准化协议或预定义轨迹，难以再现公共道路的复杂性。本文提出Video2Track框架，通过视觉语言模型提取视频语义，并利用检索增强生成映射到赛道拓扑，再结合条件扩散模型和Stackelberg博弈生成多智能体轨迹，实现可控风险与交互风格的场景变体。实验表明该框架能忠实再现真实交互场景。
items.abstract: Closed-track testing plays a fundamental role in the verification and validation of automated driving systems (ADS), particularly for safety-critical scenarios, by enabling reproducible evaluation under controlled conditions. However, most existing approaches still rely on standardized protocols or predefined trajectories, leading to overly scripted interactions and limited ability to reproduce the natural complexity of public-road traffic. To address this limitation, we propose Video2Track, a framework that trans…
keyFacts: 如何将真实世界交互视频转化为可操控的对抗性封闭赛道测试场景，以再现公共道路的复杂性？
框架包含两个模块：场景语义映射模块使用视觉语言模型提取语义，并通过检索增强生成映射到赛道拓扑库；动态交互测试模块使用条件扩散模型生成多智能体轨迹，并通过Stackelberg博弈调节交互强度。

items.title: 高海拔太赫兹太阳望远镜采集系统的电压-温度校准
items.originalTitle: Voltage-to-temperature calibration of the High Altitude THz Solar telescope acquisition system
items.summary: 太赫兹波段在太阳天文学中尚未充分探索。本文对高海拔太赫兹太阳望远镜（HATS）采集系统进行实验表征和电压-温度校准。使用黑体校准器（373.15 K至648.15 K）作为太赫兹源，比较了正弦曲线拟合和FFT结合六种窗函数的方法。结果显示系统响应高度线性，汉明窗精度最高（RMSE 15.48，标定因子10.32±0.13 mV/K），巴特利特窗误差最大。
items.abstract: The THz range has been under-explored for solar astronomy, mainly due to technological limitations. Only recently, a few new telescopes, such as the High Altitude Terahertz Solar (HATS) photometer, have been monitoring the solar activity in this range of the spectrum. This paper presents the experimental characterization and voltage-to-temperature calibration of the HATS acquisition system. HATS uses a Golay cell for capturing the incoming radiation, modulated by a 20 Hz fork chopper. The amplitude of the signal i…
keyFacts: HATS采集系统的电压-温度校准特性如何？不同信号恢复方法对校准精度有何影响？
使用黑体校准器作为THz源，对比正弦曲线拟合和FFT结合六种窗函数（矩形、汉明、汉宁、巴特利特、布莱克曼、平顶）的信号恢复方法。
系统响应在输入源温度范围内高度线性；汉明窗精度最高，RMSE为15.48，校准因子为10.32±0.13 mV/K；巴特利特窗误差最大（RMSE 16.02）；窗函数选择对标定因子影响较小，范围10.32至10.43 mV/K。

items.abstract: We present updated encircled energy (EE) curves for a subset of UVIS filters. These are derived from a reanalysis of the drizzled Point Spread Function (PSF) data underlying the current EE calibration together with new measurements from deep observations of the PSF wings. Improved centroiding and analysis techniques applied to the drizzled PSFs produce more accurate EE values at small radii ($r \le 10$ pixels), bringing the results into closer agreement with a large archival PSF study (Huynh et al. 2025). keyFacts: 如何更新WFC3/UVIS特定滤光片的包围能量值，使其更准确？

items.originalTitle: Transport properties in binary neutron star mergers: Effect of magnetic field
items.summary: 在双中子星并合的极端环境中，温度高达50 MeV，磁场高达10^17 G，中微子输运主导宏观演化。现有模拟依赖于零磁场的中微子发射率和不透明度。本文提出了有限温度和磁场下带电电流Urca发射率和中微子不透明度的精确框架，使用核子宽度近似处理碰撞展宽效应。计算表明极端磁场显著增强带电电流中微子不透明度，减少热中微子的平均自由程。
items.abstract: In extreme environments such as binary neutron star mergers, temperatures as high as $50$ MeV and magnetic fields up to $10^{17}$ G, reach a regime where neutrino transport governs the macroscopic thermodynamic and chemical evolution. Existing merger simulations rely on zero magnetic field neutrino emissivity and opacity, potentially missing critical transport physics in highly magnetized neutron star cores.
